proposals.evidence: DEDR 4876 attests Tamil, Malayalam, Kota, Toda and Kannada mīn star, and Kurux bīnkō star. These simple survey star forms belong to the shining family; compound veḷḷi-mīn responses require separate component analysis. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR 1931 attests Tamil civappu/cēppu, Malayalam cuvappu/cemappu, Kannada kempu and Tulu kempu red, showing the southern c-/k- correspondences. The selected simple colour forms fit this family; Kodagu cōpï is explicitly a Malayalam loan and Kannada Tamil-type forms are excluded from this inheritance proposal. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
